title: 第601章 傻子归来第600章 这是她们想念了十年的男人
content_zh:
陈薇薇走上前，轻轻替她拢了拢散落的发丝，又细心地将她的衣领拉好，动作温柔得近乎小心翼翼。
“楚月，”她顿了顿，声音低沉而犹豫，“你说……我们是不是太自私了？”
陈楚月的手指猛地顿住，缓缓抬起头，望向姐姐泛红的眼角，心头一紧：“姐，你这话是什么意思？”
陈薇薇沉默片刻，目光投向窗外，仿佛在整理纷乱的思绪，随后缓缓开口：“你也知道，景言心里最放不下的人，从来都是柳云烟和童梦妍。可现在，他连自己是谁都不记得了……难道我们就一直这样把他‘藏’在家里，当作只属于我们的秘密吗？”
“可他现在只认得我们啊……”陈楚月的声音轻若蚊蚋，带着浓浓的不舍与挣扎。
她低下头，手指无意识地绞着衣角，“我真的不想让他离开我们身边……可是……”
她深吸一口气，眼中泛起泪光，“姐姐说得对，我们不能永远活在自欺的牢笼里。那对他，不公平。”
陈薇薇轻轻握住妹妹冰凉的手，指尖微颤：“所以……我们明天，就把他送到紫霞宫去。”
她语气坚定，却又藏着一丝不易察觉的颤抖，“柳云烟和童梦妍一直在那里苦苦等他，整整十年。
那里有他曾经许下的誓言，有他混沌记忆深处唯一清晰的光。或许……只有回到她们身边，他才能真正找回自己。”
她没有再说下去。窗外梧桐树影婆娑，蝉鸣忽然停歇，天地间一片寂静。
微风从半开的窗棂悄然潜入，拂动她颈间的龙纹玉坠。那枚温润的玉坠轻轻磕在锁骨上，发出一声几不可闻的轻响，如同命运低语。
当天下午，陈薇薇拨通了柳云烟的电话。
她只简单地说：“我和楚月明天去紫霞宫看看你们。”
却始终没有透露陈景言已经回来的消息——她想给他，也给她们，一个真正的重逢。
第二天……中午时分，阳光正好，微风轻拂，陈薇薇与陈楚月并肩而行，带着神情木讷的陈景言缓缓步入紫霞宫山门。
她们二人虽为陈景言名义上的姐姐，实则情同手足，多年来始终挂念着他的一举一动。
得知她们今日携陈景言前来，柳云烟与童梦妍早已心绪难平，早早便带着各自的孩子守候在紫霞宫巍峨庄严的正门口，翘首以盼。
远远望见陈家姐妹的身影，柳云烟与童梦妍的目光瞬间落在她们身后那个熟悉又陌生的男人身上——他身形依旧清瘦却挺拔如松，眉目轮廓一如往昔，只是那双曾锐利如刀、锋芒毕露的眼眸，如今却显得黯淡无光，仿佛被岁月悄然磨去了所有锐气与神采。
然而，即便如此，她们还是一眼认出了他——这正是她们日思夜想、魂牵梦萦了整整十年的男人。

“景言……”
“景言……”
两人几乎同时哽咽出声，再也按捺不住心中翻涌的情绪，快步奔上前去，紧紧将他拥入怀中，仿佛生怕一松手，他又会消失不见。
content_en:
Chen Weiwei stepped forward, gently gathered her loose hair, and carefully pulled her collar back up, her movements almost gentle and careful.
"Chu Yue," she paused, her voice low and hesitant, "Do you think... are we too selfish?"
Chen Chuyue's fingers suddenly stopped, she slowly raised her head, looked at her sister's red eyes, and her heart tightened: "Sister, what do you mean by this?"
Chen Weiwei was silent for a moment, looking out the window, as if sorting out her chaotic thoughts, and then slowly spoke: "You also know that the people Jing Yan can't let go of the most have always been Liu Yunyan and Tong Mengyan. But now, he doesn't even remember who he is... Do we keep 'hiding' him at home like this, treating him as a secret that only belongs to us?"
"But he only recognizes us now..." Chen Chuyue's voice was as light as a gnat, full of reluctance and struggle.
She lowered her head and twisted her clothes unconsciously with her fingers, "I really don't want him to leave our side...but..."
She took a deep breath, tears welling up in her eyes, "Sister is right, we can't live in a cage of self-deception forever. That's not fair to him."
Chen Weiwei gently held her sister's cold hand, her fingertips trembling slightly: "So... we will send him to Zixia Palace tomorrow."
Her tone was firm, but there was a hint of unnoticeable trembling, "Liu Yunyan and Tong Mengyan have been waiting there for him for a full ten years.
There was the oath he had made, and the only clear light in the depths of his chaotic memory. Perhaps...only by returning to them can he truly find himself. "
She said no more. The shadows of the plane trees outside the window were whirling, the chirping of the cicadas suddenly stopped, and there was silence between heaven and earth.
The breeze quietly sneaked in through the half-open window lattice, fluttering the dragon-patterned jade pendant around her neck. The warm jade pendant gently knocked on the collarbone, making an almost inaudible sound, like the whisper of fate.
That afternoon, Chen Weiwei called Liu Yunyan's phone number.
She simply said: "Chu Yue and I will go to Zixia Palace to see you tomorrow."
But she never revealed the news that Chen Jingyan had come back - she wanted to give him, and them, a real reunion.
The next day... At noon, the sun was just right and the breeze was gentle. Chen Weiwei and Chen Chuyue walked side by side, and slowly walked into the mountain gate of Zixia Palace with Chen Jingyan, who looked dull.
Although the two of them are Chen Jingyan's sisters in name, they are actually like brothers and have been thinking about his every move for many years.
Knowing that they were coming with Chen Jingyan today, Liu Yunyan and Tong Mengyan were already upset. They had been waiting at the majestic main entrance of Zixia Palace with their children early, looking forward to it.
Seeing the figures of the Chen sisters from a distance, Liu Yunyan and Tong Mengyan's eyes instantly fell on the familiar yet unfamiliar man behind them - he was still as thin but as tall as a pine, and the outline of his eyebrows was the same as before, but the eyes that were once as sharp as a knife, now looked dull, as if all the vigor and vitality had been quietly worn away by the years.
However, even so, they recognized him at a glance - this was the man they had been thinking about day and night and dreaming about for ten years.
"Jing Yan..."
"Jing Yan..."
The two of them choked up almost at the same time. Unable to suppress the surging emotions in their hearts, they quickly ran forward and hugged him tightly, as if they were afraid that if they let go, he would disappear again.
